document: a block of chapters inside a longer review or book, numbered from CHAPTER
figures: one per major section plus one overview
boxes: for derivations; main text keeps results

style.attribution: concept, mechanism or claim as the grammatical subject of the topic sentence, citation at the end of the clause; key works introduced with lead authors and year ('In 2024, A, B and colleagues reported ... [3]', then 'The same team ...'); reference-as-subject ('[3] reported') only where the venue uses it; one convention throughout (see references/review-architecture.md)

must_have: check whether the parent document has its own challenges or outlook chapter; if so, end the block on a short synthesis
cross-reference co-authors' chapters instead of repeating them
